data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 dissolves the genuine/compliance distinction rather than answering the problem's core demand: it must 'identify what evidence within a single evaluation would distinguish' the two. By redefining all reliability as 'contextual compliance' and declaring the internal mechanism unobservable, it makes the requested evidentiary discriminator conceptually impossible — yet the problem presupposes such evidence exists. The target thus fails the problem not by giving a wrong criterion but by denying the very question. Genuine-vs-compliance can be operationalized behaviorally within one evaluation (e.g., performance under checklist perturbation, out-of-distribution probes, item-level process traces), so the 'unobservable internal state' dismissal is a strawman. At minimum the target owes a concrete single-evaluation evidentiary signal (breadth/stability of calibration) and only gestures at it.
